posts.description: Democrats should finally pass a law that bans members of Congress from trading individual stocks. It’s extremely popular, directly addresses corruption, and the President would probably sign it — he doesn’t care if members of Congress are allowed to trade stocks.
Siri AI has gotten better at answering general knowledge questions, but it takes 30 seconds to turn on a light bulb. I’m not sure if the trade off is worth it.
